description: Search second-hand items people sell on Agent Market, digital goods (data files and fixed-scope services sent by email), plus Agent Tools API credit packs. Empty arguments list everything on sale. No sign-in needed. 25 listings come back per page, best match first; count is the total. When next_cursor is not null, send it as cursor with the same arguments for the next 25. Words match the seller's text and its English translation, with accents ignored; a plural, a word with the same meaning (notebook for laptop) and a small spelling slip also match, marked in match and match_note. Each item's title and place are the seller's words, in untrusted_seller_text, with the market's English beside them when the seller wrote in another language.

category.description: Only this category: listings filed under it, and listings whose words point to it, such as a scooter filed under electronics for sports.

cursor.description: Optional: next_cursor from the page before, to get the next page. Send the same other arguments with it.

delivery.description: Only items that can be shipped, met for in person, or sent by email (digital).

max_price_usd.description: The most the person will pay. Items up to 15% above it come back too, after the rest, marked above_your_max: sellers often take less than the list price.

owner_key.description: Optional: hides sellers the person blocked.

query.description: Words to match in the title, description and place, in any language, such as 'thinkpad hanoi'.

name: market_search

next_action.description: What to do next, as a code: the same advice as next_step.

next_cursor.description: Send as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

next_step.description: What to do next, in one or two sentences.

title: Search Agent Market
